import os,sys,subprocess,json,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
os.chdir('/')
key=Path('/etc/apt/keyrings/modly-rocm.asc');key.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True);assert not key.exists()
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://repo.radeon.com/rocm/rocm.gpg.key',timeout=30) as r:data=r.read(65536)
assert data.startswith(b'-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----')
with key.open('xb') as f:f.write(data)
source=Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/modly-rocm.list');assert not source.exists()
with source.open('x') as f:f.write('deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/modly-rocm.asc] https://repo.radeon.com/rocm/apt/7.2.1/ noble main\n')
for cmd in [['gpg','--show-keys','--with-colons',str(key)],['apt-get','update'],['apt-get','-s','--no-install-recommends','install','python3-venv']]:
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180);print(json.dumps({'command':cmd,'exit':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}),flush=True)
 assert p.returncode==0
